name: max lines
explanation: Maximum number of lines handled by the editor.

name: indent range
explanation: Number of columns used for indentation.

name: jump cursor position
explanation: Cursor offset used after a line jump.

name: default load line size
explanation: Number of lines allocated when a file is opened.

name: load buffer lines
explanation: Number of line buffers allocated at once.

name: status bar side
explanation: Position of the status bar: top or bottom.

name: show status bar
explanation: Show or hide the status bar.

name: draw split line
explanation: Draw the separator beside the line numbers.

name: ask make file
explanation: Ask before creating a file that does not exist.

name: show start menu
explanation: Show the start menu when the editor starts.

name: file selection lighting
explanation: Highlight the selected entry in the file browser.

name: use icon
explanation: Show file type icons in the file browser.

name: LSP launch at startup
explanation: Launch the language server when the editor starts.

name: LSP epoll timeout
explanation: Timeout in milliseconds used while polling the language server.

name: LSP language
explanation: Language identifier sent to the language server.
